attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file South Dakota corporate tax return. South Dakota has NO corporate income tax - no filing required.

condition_details.condition_comment: General business corporation (not financial institution or insurance company)
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.sd_is_financial_institution false beq { pop result.sd_is_insurance_company false beq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Financial institution subject to Bank Franchise Tax
Insurance company subject to Insurance Premium Tax

action_details.action_comment: General corporation - no corporate income tax; South Dakota has NO corporate income tax for general corporations
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.sd_no_corporate_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "South Dakota has NO corporate income tax. Any estimated payments are refunded. Reference: SD Constitution Article XI" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Financial institution - Bank Franchise Tax (NOT income tax); Financial institutions pay Bank Franchise Tax (separate from general corporate taxation)
action_details.action_postfix: result.sd_bank_franchise_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef "SD Bank Franchise Tax applies (NOT corporate income tax). Reference: SDCL 10-43" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Insurance company - Insurance Premium Tax (NOT income tax); Insurance companies pay Insurance Premium Tax (separate from general corporate taxation)
action_details.action_postfix: result.sd_insurance_premium_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef "SD Insurance Premium Tax applies (NOT corporate income tax). Reference: SDCL 10-44" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: South Dakota has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.sd_is_financial_institution false beq { pop result.sd_is_insurance_company false beq } over if

action_details.action_comment: General corporation - no income tax adjustments; South Dakota has NO corporate income tax - no adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_taxable_income xdef "SD has NO corporate income tax. No adjustments needed." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Specialized entity - no income adjustments; Financial institution or insurance company - no income tax adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "Specialized entity (financial/insurance) - no income tax adjustments." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate South Dakota corporate tax liability. South Dakota has NO corporate income tax - tax is always $0.

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.sd_is_financial_institution false beq { pop result.sd_is_insurance_company false beq } over if

action_details.action_comment: General corporation - $0 tax; South Dakota has NO corporate income tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef true /result.sd_no_corporate_tax xdef "South Dakota Corporate Tax: $0. NO corporate income tax, NO franchise tax, NO gross receipts tax. Any estimated payments refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Specialized entity - tax already calculated; Financial institution or insurance company - tax calculated in table 54500
